episodes.synopsis: Shigure finds herself assigned to the 1st Striking Force 3rd Division for an important upcoming operation along with a surprising variety of other Fleet Girls. What will their role in the next big offensive against the Abyssals be?
episodes.title: Sortie Day

episodes.synopsis: The Fleet Girls of 1st Striking Force 3rd Division head into the Surigao Strait, and begin to engage the Abyssals in combat.
episodes.title: Into the Strait

episodes.synopsis: Yamashiro and her fleet face off against the Abyssals at night in the Surigao Strait.
episodes.title: Night Battle in the Strait

episodes.synopsis: Shigure takes a short break before the next stage of the war begins.
episodes.title: Sasebo

episodes.synopsis: Torpedo Squadron 2 does a large-scale training exercise to prepare for the next big battle.
episodes.title: Torpedo Squadron 2

episodes.synopsis: Shigure is sent on a dangerous undermanned escort mission with her old comrade, Ryuuhou.
episodes.title: Dark Clouds

episodes.synopsis: A prelude to the final battle of the war is about to begin.
episodes.title: Naval Interception Mission

episodes.synopsis: The enemy is approaching, and all the allied forces throw themselves heart and soul into the last battle.
episodes.title: See You Again on Another Quiet Blue Sea
